stateMap.formula: bands = min(7, floor(plies / 6)); band k (1..7) is coloured from ply 6k; on checkmate all 7 sweep in (1.6 s); draw / stalemate / resign leave it as is
x = 5.25 + 1.7 * min(1, plies / 120); at any game end the snail glides the rest of the way in 3 s
star starOrder[k] is lowered (thread +0.35, eyes closed, sways at half speed) for the k-th captured Dusk piece; count = tally.byWhite.length
ray j is dim (dotted stub) for the j-th captured Sunrise piece, ray order = clockwise from the top-right; count = tally.byBlack.length (16 rays, the king ray never dims)
spots = min(7, total captures); the 7th spot: she counts them on her fingers and shrugs
sleeper i (i < 10) = tally.byWhite[i] piece type, tucked in on napDusk[i]; more than 10 captures: the extras are only zzz above the whale
boat i (i < 6) = tally.byBlack[i] piece type on napSunrise[i]; more than 6: extras are zzz bubbles on the water
seeds = max(0, 24 - fullMoves); one seed leaves per completed full move; at game end the clock lets go of all of them (3 s) and stays bare
lines drawn = min(13, fullMoves); dot k is inked when line k-1 reaches it; completes = a star-bell
grey (board-paper fmn-grey-N) while the game runs; on checkmate / resign with a winner every one swaps to its blue twin (crossfade 0.9 s); they stay grey on a draw

localStorage record of this browser (last 15 results): tally-N strings of the lettering kit, warm = Sunrise won, cool = Dusk won, a draw adds one short stroke of each hand; every 5th stroke is the diagonal
the pen of the side to move is awake (cap off, tip inked), the other capped and asleep; both capped after a game ends
side to move: awake and smiling; other side: dozing (half lids). at game start only the sun is awake (QUIET)
a new pair every 6 plies from pool index floor(plies/6) mod 8 (deterministic); wiped with a tiny eraser scribble, rewritten by draw-on

workPackages.name: Integrator (atlas packing, src/world runtime, WorldState, dockLayout port)
workPackages.note: reads layout.json; the only writer of the shared atlas and manifest; runs `node tools/lab-world-check.mjs` in its gate.

integration: each WP writes only its own folder public/assets/world/<wp>/: one PNG per frame (+ `.t.png` time map where a state says draw-on), one `static-<region>.png` per region it owns, and `frames.json` {frameId: {file, ppu, pivot, anchors, meta}} keyed by the ids of layout.json (`<actorId>.<state>.<n>`, boil variants `.b0/.b1/.b2`); deterministic (seeded) and re-runnable; WPs never write an atlas or a shared manifest
the integrator (WP I) packs all frames.json into ONE atlas `world` (art/kit/atlas.mjs, <= 2 colour pages) and writes public/assets/world/manifest.json; the statics stay separate textures for sheet.ts
statics: one ink-only PNG per region (straight alpha, `paper: null` solve) + time map page, rect from layout.json; sheet.ts composites them on the paper and draws them on at the opening
every actor id in layout.json has: all listed states present as frames, a `pivot` at the foot (stand) or the centre (flat), `ppu` in the manifest, boil variants named `<frame>.b0/.b1/.b2`
the three cast members (dab, gus, dot) have full rigs like the pieces (parts + anchors) and are the only ones with eye tracking

world/ (runtime) reads layout.json + a WorldState, picks mode W/S/T from the aspect (hysteresis 0.05), applies dockLayout(), culls elements with cull:"full", subscribes to the 21 events (layout.json `reactions`)

lettering: `node tools/lab-world-strings.mjs` writes art/lettering/strings.d/world-director.json and validates it with the lettering kit's own loader; every id used by layout.json exists in public/assets/text/manifest.json after `node art/lettering/bake.mjs`

Node checks: `node tools/lab-world-check.mjs` (0 problems at all 11 aspects), `node art/world/layout-sketch.mjs` re-renders the composition; a contact sheet of each WP's frames in the true perspective at 1.33 / 1.78 / 0.56
density audit on the assembled sheet: ink 5-12 %, 35-60 % of 90 px cells empty outside the board; colour: the page at game start has colour only on Dab, sun, moon (pale) and the pieces / sage squares
lead verifies in WebKit (one window): the opening, one capture (ants + sleeper + star + spot + ray), check, checkmate finale, undo, newGame, portrait window
